name: Gulf South Gas Pipeline / Carthage to Keatchie Pipeline Loop

values.SegmentName: GS Carthage to Keatchie Pipeline Loop
values.StartLocation: Carthage Junction Compressor Station, Panola County

researcher_notes: Not a match to existing rows. P5932 (Texas to Mississippi Expansion, 243 miles) starts at Keatchie, Louisiana, and no existing Gulf South row covers the Texas to Louisiana loop. A Federal Register notice from May 2006 (FERC docket CP06-127, blanket certificate request) describes 20.5 miles of 42-inch loop from the Carthage Junction Compressor Station in Panola County, Texas, to Keatchie in DeSoto Parish, Louisiana, laid next to the existing 24-inch Index 266 line. The EIA historical projects table (August 2026 release, sheet Historical Projects 1996-2024, Excel row 428) lists it as completed December 2006, 20.5 miles, 42 inch, 122.4 MMcf/d added, cost 47.9 million (not staged, no ref names cost in a second source). Length 20.5 mi is about 33 km, over the 25 km rule. Two independent origins: FERC filing and EIA. Owner not staged: sources name only Gulf South Pipeline; sibling rows use Boardwalk Pipeline Partners / Loews Corp, to be set at apply time. Start year taken from the EIA completion date. Route: no official GIS found; the corridor runs beside Index 266, so a human may draw a low-accuracy route later.
